rawContent: I know from first hand experience that survivors are forced to work within a system to change a system. I want to change everything. #MeToo

I want to be at the front of proactive change, of change I determine and define for myself. I am leading where I can and learning where I need to. I will not be used to move people on their supposed values, I’m here to lead and operationalize my own. #MeToo

Shifts in power are vital, naming power is important - scary, but important. I'm grateful to every survivor + victim who is doing this work. Doing it in their personal lives, schools, companies, on scales of all sizes. I see you, I hear you, I believe you, I’m with you. #MeToo

Healing is not linear, it’s not a race. There is no finish line. It looks different for everyone. There is no hierarchy of pain or trauma. There’s no comparison: “well you went through something worse” or “what happened to me isn’t that bad”. #MeToo

We are all brave, I promise you. I see it first hand all the time. We are all unintended experts in trauma, the legal system, PTSD, explaining triggers to people, navigating the world as a new person (post assault), it’s exhausting. But we do it, and we are amazing #MeToo
We are all healing from something, take time with yourself. Be kind, be gentle. Remember, this is not a race. Practice the same compassion with yourself that you’d want for a friend. #MeToo
